title: Number of Digit One
summary: Determine the total occurrences of the digit one in all non-negative integers up to a specified integer n.
statement: Determine the total occurrences of the digit one in all non-negative integers up to a specified integer n.
constraints: Count every occurrence of digit '1' in the ordinary decimal representations of all integers from 0 through n inclusive. Leading zeroes are not written.
hints: Count ones independently at the ones, tens, hundreds, and higher positions.
At place p, split n into digits higher than p, the current digit, and lower digits.
Add high×p for full cycles, then add 0, low+1, or p according as the current digit is 0, 1, or greater than 1.
Advance p by a factor of ten. This avoids enumerating up to one billion numbers.
editorial: For each decimal place, every complete block of 10p numbers contributes p ones at that place. The current partial block contributes nothing when its digit is zero, lower+1 when it is one, and a full p when greater. Summing all places counts each written one exactly once. The independent oracle converts and counts every number for bounded seeded inputs; the full 10^9 boundary has a separately derived closed-form fixture.

tests.explanation: The only included number is 0, whose representation contains no digit 1.
